## Saved Models print exports in Windows 0.24.33

Select a model in 3D Studio, choose GLB, STL or 3MF in the selection bar, and click Export. GLB preserves the original appearance. Binary STL and compressed 3MF export the mesh geometry in Z-up print coordinates. Generated sculptures use a proportional 100 mm longest dimension in both print formats. Scene-editor designs retain their numeric dimensions. The formats are available for existing saves without running generation again. The selected revision is fixed when the dialog opens.

## STL and 3MF export, Windows 0.24.33

Tested a previously generated five-part owl in the packaged native Windows gallery. Selected each format, used its real Save As dialog, tested cancellation, and checked that GLB remained byte-identical. An independent mesh comparison checked all 147,799 exported triangles against the source GLB, including coordinates and winding. Both formats matched and both opened in ElegooSlicer. Native tests also checked transformed scene geometry, shared corners, scaling, invalid input, saved revisions, and overwrite protection.
